# OR-009: Follow carbon through esterification and alkaline cleavage
# Candidate experiment; expected observations are not measured results.
register lv3
add v1 CH3COOH 0.01mol
add v1 ethanol 0.01mol
react v1 esterification
inspect v1
add v1 water 20mL
add v1 NaOH 0.02mol
react v1 saponification
inspect v1
